instances.claim: This tells me that the work is continually redefined and never settled — three times, in three sets of words, at the same level of abstraction.
instances.why: Line 16 has already stated redefinition as a mechanism (consensus re-pricing the inscribed cent) and line 20 has given it a reader (collectors working the set), so 17 and 21 are left asserting the same abstract property of the whole — 'ongoing process of redefinition' and 'indeterminate and continually redefined' — with 22's 'unfolds continually' repeating it a third time. Only 22 adds a register, naming what kind of thing the work is; 17 and 21 differ from it in vocabulary, not in level, and cutting them loses no claim.
